intro.ja: 「駒の動き」で学んだ形を、実際に手順を指して確認します。
intro.en: Play through the moves to check what you learned in “Piece movement”.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 玉の斜め移動
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: King: one diagonal step

branches.note: 玉の斜め移動を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A king moves one square diagonally; the destination must be unattacked. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 飛車の横移動
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Rook: an open rank

branches.note: 飛車の横移動を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A rook slides horizontally through empty squares. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 角の斜め移動
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Bishop: an open diagonal

branches.note: 角の斜め移動を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A bishop slides diagonally; decline optional promotion for this movement example. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 金の横移動
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Gold: one sideways step

branches.note: 金の横移動を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A gold can move one square sideways. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 銀の斜め後退
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Silver: retreat diagonally

branches.note: 銀の斜め後退を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: An unpromoted silver can retreat diagonally, unlike a gold. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 桂の跳躍
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Knight: jump over a blocker

branches.note: 桂の跳躍を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A knight jumps two ranks forward and one file sideways, even over a friendly blocker. Decline optional promotion here. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 香の直進
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Lance: forward along a file

branches.note: 香の直進を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A lance slides forward through an open file. Decline optional promotion here. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 歩の一歩
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Pawn: one forward step

branches.note: 歩の一歩を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A pawn moves one square straight forward. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 龍の斜め移動
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Dragon: added diagonal step

branches.note: 龍の斜め移動を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A dragon retains rook movement and adds a one-square diagonal move. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 馬の横移動
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Horse: added sideways step

branches.note: 馬の横移動を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A horse retains bishop movement and adds a one-square orthogonal move. This is an original simplified position.

courses.title: 駒の動き・練習問題: 成銀の横移動
courses.titleEn: Piece movement practice: Promoted silver: gold movement

branches.note: 成銀の横移動を確認します。独自の簡略局面です。
branches.noteEn: A promoted silver moves as a gold, so a sideways step is legal. This is an original simplified position.
